slides.lead: the calm starts before you even unpack.
slides.headline:
the *safest* little
capital in europe
slides.body: five reasons slovenia might be your *easiest* first solo trip. save it for later.

slides.head: why women go *alone* here
slides.body: low crime, walkable everything, and locals who switch to english the second you look lost.

slides.head: the old town is *car-free*
slides.body: just the river, the bridges and cafe tables. nothing to dodge, nowhere to rush.

slides.head: the *view*
slides.body: ride the funicular up to ljubljana castle. rooftops on one side, the alps on the other.

slides.head: the tip *no one* gives you
slides.body: hop the free kavalir electric buggy through the old town. locals use it, most tourists never spot it.

slides.head: one *easy* day trip
slides.body: lake bled is 40 minutes by bus. island church, a lake walk, back before dinner.

slides.lead: five small reasons. one easier first trip.
slides.headline: *save this* for your next trip
slides.tagline: solo travel for women, minus the fear
